record.context_brief: Classification and algebraic analogs of holomorphic sectional curvature
record.original_question: Do blow-ups of Hirzebruch surfaces admit positive holomorphic sectional curvature? More broadly, can one classify all varieties of a fixed dimension, for example dimension two or three, with semi-positive or positive holomorphic sectional curvature, and can one identify an algebraic-geometric analog of semi-positive or positive holomorphic sectional curvature?

evidence.quote: Does the blow-up of Hirzebruch surfaces admit a positive holomorphic sectional curvature?
Can we classify all the varieties of fixed dimension (e.g., dimension two or three) with semi-positive (or positive) holomorphic sectional curvature?
Can we find an analog of semi-positive (or positive) holomorphic sectional curvatures in algebraic geometry?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Background and definitions. Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Kähler manifold of complex dimension $n$ with Kähler metric $g$ and associated Chern (or equivalently Levi-Civita) connection on the holomorphic tangent bundle $T^{1,0}X$. For a nonzero holomorphic tangent vector $v\in T^{1,0}_pX$, the holomorphic sectional curvature is
$$H(v) \;=\; \frac{R(v,\bar v,v,\bar v)}{|v|_g^4},$$
where $R$ is the curvature tensor of $g$. One says that $(X,\omega)$ has positive (resp. semi-positive) holomorphic sectional curvature if $H(v)>0$ (resp. $H(v)\ge 0$) for every nonzero $v$ at every point of $X$. We say a complex manifold $X$ admits positive (resp. semi-positive) holomorphic sectional curvature if some Kähler metric on $X$ has this property.

Recall that the $k$-th Hirzebruch surface is $\Sigma_k=\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}\oplus \mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(k))$ for $k\ge 0$. It is known that every Hirzebruch surface admits a Kähler metric of positive holomorphic sectional curvature.

Problems.
(a) Let $\tilde\Sigma_k$ denote the blow-up of a Hirzebruch surface $\Sigma_k$ at one (or finitely many) points. Does $\tilde\Sigma_k$ admit a Kähler metric of positive holomorphic sectional curvature?

(b) Classify all smooth projective varieties of complex dimension $2$ (respectively, dimension $3$) that admit a Kähler metric of positive holomorphic sectional curvature, and likewise those admitting one of semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature.

(c) Find a purely algebro-geometric notion (a property of the variety, of its tangent bundle, or of suitable cohomology classes) that is equivalent to, or serves as a natural analog of, the existence of a Kähler metric of positive (respectively semi-positive) holomorphic sectional curvature.
artifact.category_tag: Holomorphic sectional curvature of Kähler manifolds
artifact.status_search_result: Searches surface foundational results by Hitchin (rational surfaces only in dim 2) and Yang–Zheng (positive holomorphic sectional curvature on Hirzebruch manifolds), plus follow-up work by Alvarez–Chaturvedi–Heier on fibrations, but no published classification of surfaces/threefolds with positive or semi-positive holomorphic sectional curvature, no resolution of the blow-up of Hirzebruch case, and no accepted algebro-geometric analog. The problem appears to remain open as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Hirzebruch manifolds and positive holomorphic sectional curvature
status_evidence.snippet: Yang–Zheng prove that every Hirzebruch manifold admits a Kähler metric of positive holomorphic sectional curvature in each Kähler class.
status_evidence.claim: Existence is established for Hirzebruch manifolds themselves, but not for their blow-ups.

status_evidence.title: Hermitian metrics of positive holomorphic sectional curvature on fibrations
status_evidence.snippet: If base and fibers admit Hermitian metrics of positive HSC, so does the total space.
status_evidence.claim: Recent progress concerns fibrations, not blow-ups; classification still missing.

status_evidence.title: Complete Kähler metrics with positive holomorphic sectional curvatures on certain line bundles
status_evidence.snippet: 2024 paper on positive HSC for special line bundle total spaces, related to a Yau conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Active 2024 research without resolving the blow-up or classification questions.
